issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing internal_calc as a private helper (explicitly 'not global'), but the solution export declares internal_calc as global in helloWorld.asm. This contradicts the visibility requirement and may confuse students about whether the helper should be exported.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the problem statement by removing the 'global internal_calc' directive so internal_calc remains non-exported (private). If the helper must be global for technical reasons, update the problem statement to explicitly allow a global helper and explain why.
